# ADR-NNN: decision title

Status: proposed / accepted / superseded. Date and owner: UNKNOWN.
Affected requirements/tickets/contracts: UNKNOWN.

## Evidence and problem

Record source revisions, observed constraints and the engineering decision.
Distinguish user-confirmed inputs from provisional assumptions.

## Options and decision

Compare correctness, timing fidelity, integration effort, portability and evidence
cost. State chosen option, rationale and alternatives rejected. Do not infer
protocol behavior from naming or choose numeric accuracy tolerances without an owner.

## Consequences and validation

List interfaces changed, migration path, tests/gates, operational limits, and
the event/evidence that would cause reconsideration. Link superseded ADRs without
rewriting historical rationale.
